decision: Product pivot (operator-locked): the agent operator brief is the PRIMARY surface; the dashboard becomes a structured state projection + inspectable evidence surface. The human works in their CLI/agent, not a dashboard.

Build the triage MODEL as the single source of truth FIRST (F001-F003); both the agent brief (F004) and the GUI (F006/F007) render it. Do not let narration outrun the data contract — the prototype proved the SHAPE (raw inventory vs operator-ready triage), not an exact human-workload number.

operator_bucket is DERIVED by one pure/total classifier, never producer-asserted. Keep four axes distinct: resolution_class (how it clears) / automatable (a command exists, no judgment) / safety_class (may DontPanic apply it) / operator_bucket (who acts now). auto_safe is a strict subset of automatable.

safety_class stays in the repair projection; the classifier CONSUMES it rather than adding it to the ActionItem envelope (verified: ActionItem in operator_console.py carries resolution_class/automatable/audience/dedupe_key/band/clears_when/human_required_reason but NOT safety_class/operator_bucket).

uncertain is the render-truth contract (plan 2026-06-04-005) applied to triage: missing/stale inputs -> uncertain bucket with a data-quality reason, surfaced not hidden. The brief reports uncertainty/staleness instead of asserting a clean count.

Auto-run is NOT default. Safe-tier apply (F005) is opt-in, dry-run-first, logged, reversible, auto_safe-only, and hard-refuses credentials/approvals/project mutations. Surprise mutation is where a trust tool loses trust. A config flag may later enable it for pure cache/state projection.

The GUI is the inspectable evidence surface, NOT an optional glance: the agent compresses ('4 need you'), the GUI audits the compression (which 4, why the rest were hidden, what may run, what was handled).
Naming: dontpanic operator brief (not 'brief') — 'dontpanic agent brief' already exists as the setup/operating brief. Avoids collision.

Acceptance is operator-OUTCOME via named journeys (H1-H6, A1-A4) proven on real producer state, NOT DOM-render correctness. This is the qa-sufficiency gap that let the 313-card wall ship: 'rendered 313 cards correctly' passed; 'a human finds what needs them in <10s' was never tested.

Three data bugs surfaced by docs/prototypes/triage_digest.py and folded into phase 1: (1) operator_bucket/safety_class absent from envelope -> fail-closed mislabel (F001), (2) approval items duplicated 6-8x (F002), (3) stale gates from closed plans surfaced as live (F003).

NAMED DEPENDENCY for the GUI (F006): build writes fleet state to ~/.dontpanic/dashboard/ while serve reads <repo>/dashboard/state/ — 'No fleet summary yet' on every tab. F006 resolves or explicitly defers the serve-path. Separate from the now-fixed test-pollution bug (commit ff6f986).

The GUI is a first-class DUAL-MODE operator console (Observer + Operator), not merely an inspectable evidence pane. Revises D001/D002: the agent brief is primary when the human is in their CLI/Cursor; the operator console is primary when the human operates from DontPanic directly. Both render the one F001 model.

GUI affordance model (F008): tiered, confirm-gated, evidence-writing per bucket. needs_decision -> confirm-gated approve/request-changes/reject via the governed CLI/MCP local-serve action channel (a BOUNDED action channel limited to named buckets, never a free shell) OR copy-command handoff. needs_auth -> setup command + copy/open (credentials stay human). agent_runnable -> copy-command / copy-run-plan / open-in-terminal-or-agent. auto_safe -> dry-run-then-confirm driving the F005 engine seam. Plus mark-run-externally+attach-evidence and refresh-triage. The read-only->bounded-operator shift is deliberate; every mutating path confirms and writes/links evidence.

Removed the brittle '<=5 actionable items' invariant (review: it is not a correctness property; 9 legit live approvals must show 9). Correctness = the default view shows ALL unique live needs_auth+needs_decision, deduped+gate-reconciled, non-human buckets collapsed, NOT capped. The 313 -> expected-unique-human-count collapse is a SEPARATE fixture assertion.

F005 is the CLI safe-tier ENGINE, exposed as a callable seam; F008 is the GUI affordance that drives the same seam with identical dry-run/confirm/evidence rules. One engine, two entry points — resolves the prior CLI-only ambiguity.

Surface-tag cleanup (plan-review): F004 acceptance separates model/source-parity vs CLI-rendering and no longer calls itself 'dashboard' (removing the spurious cli+dashboard double-tag); F007/F008 reworded as operator-console/dashboard surfaces. Remaining plan-review 'unresolved symbol' flags (operator_bucket, data_quality, auto_safe, --text) are NEW symbols this plan DEFINES — accepted-as-known at lock, not real missing prereqs.

LAYOUT = operator workbench: one model, three coordinated panes — LEFT triage queue (bucket counts + data-quality, default-filtered to Needs You) / CENTER current work (per-bucket render + actions, one-line 'why now') / RIGHT context-evidence tabs (Evidence/Plan/Diff/Tests/History/Why-Hidden) — plus a TOP status+mode bar and a BOTTOM activity strip; narrow viewports collapse to status->bucket-tabs->item->evidence-accordion->activity. Refinements over the proposal: (1) the workbench is the ONLY view — bucket counts FILTER the left queue, never open a separate grid; (2) Uncertain rides WITH Needs You (honesty bucket), not buried below Quiet; (3) evidence is rendered ONCE in the right pane, center carries only a one-line why-now; (4) Operator mode is visually unmistakable and every mutation confirms regardless of mode; (5) the activity strip and the what-was-handled log are ONE evidence source rendered twice; (6) 'send to agent' v0 = copy-run-plan/open-in-terminal, live-dispatch-to-running-agent deferred to the OpenClaw/Hermes runtime; (7) the '313 -> N unique -> M need you' pipeline line is a first-class render-truth artifact. Pane->feature map: F006 renders LEFT+TOP, F007 renders RIGHT+activity log, F008 renders CENTER actions + the mode switch.

POSTURE (locked): v0 GUI is an operator workbench with COPY/OPEN/HANDOFF/REFRESH only — NOT a browser executor. No GUI button originates a mutation (no browser-invoked dontpanic approve, no browser-invoked triage apply --confirm). Making the console an executor is a new trust boundary needing its own threat model (local-server auth, CSRF, origin restriction, command allowlist, confirmation semantics, evidence atomicity, failure recovery, replay/idempotency, audit-log integrity, stale-tab handling) and is deferred to a SEPARATE plan: 2026-06-06-002 Governed GUI Action Channel v1.

Even mark-run-externally + attach-evidence is a COMMAND HANDOFF in v0 (a generated command the human/agent runs to record evidence), NOT a GUI-originated file write — so the console originates zero state change in v0. Revises D013's affordance model accordingly.

Supersedes D013's 'governed CLI/MCP local-serve action channel': F008 is COPY/OPEN/HANDOFF/REFRESH only. needs_decision -> approve/request/reject INTENT then copy-command/open-terminal; auto_safe -> copy dry-run + --confirm commands / open-terminal; agent_runnable -> copy-command/copy-run-plan/open-in-terminal-or-agent (v0 send-to-agent = copy/open, not live dispatch). The browser never mutates.

Corrects D016's overclaim: the F001/F005/F008 multi-surface plan-review blocks were REAL (the text mixed model/renderer/action-channel concerns), not symbol noise. Fixes: model features (F001-F003) are wording-pure (no CLI/dashboard refs); model-parity moved INTO F001 as a pinned canonical serialization; F004 is command-line only; F005 is command-line only (kept because the auto_safe handoff + agent run-plan A2 need a real command to exist; browser-invoke deferred to 2026-06-06-002); F006/F007/F008 are browser/GUI only and F008 executes nothing. Remaining flags (operator_bucket/data_quality/auto_safe/--text as 'unresolved symbols') are genuine new symbols this plan defines, accepted-as-known.

Concurrency is a MODEL concern first (same lesson as operator_bucket): F001 carries per-item scope + derived run_state (idle/running/conflicted) + coarse actor label + a state_revision fingerprint, so EVERY surface (brief, CLI, MCP, GUI) sees parallel work, not just the GUI. All derived READ-ONLY by joining the item's plan_id to live SupervisorEntry records in the existing active-supervisors registry + evidence + a model hash. The only producer change is an optional SupervisorEntry.register enrichment (agent vendor + session label) for the richer actor chip.

v0 SURFACES parallel state (running/conflicted/stale) read-only; it does not COORDINATE. Item-level claim/lease (reserve-before-act), conflict RESOLUTION (not just surfacing), and refusal-before-mutation are write/coordination primitives — DEFERRED. Refusal-before-mutation pairs with the governed action channel (2026-06-06-002); claim/lease + conflict-resolution get their own slice when demanded.

v0 parallel-ops is scoped to LOCAL-MACHINE multi-process — the real described setup (one Mac: GUI + Cursor + terminal-1 Claude + terminal-2 Codex), all readable from the local active-supervisors registry. Multi-machine awareness needs a shared ledger and is future.

Per review, the all-in-one F008 is SPLIT into three single-purpose features: F008 per-bucket handoff AFFORDANCES (copy/open/run-plan, presentation only) / F009 handoff LIFECYCLE + refresh (mode switch, mark-run-externally, attach-evidence, refresh, your-own-view stale) / F010 PARALLEL operation awareness (scope chips, running/conflicted, activity grouped by actor+project, stale/conflict surfacing, journeys P1-P6). Accept the new-symbol lint noise; the F008 over_surface/timeout block is resolved by the split, NOT accepted.

scope (global vs project) is first-class in F001. The GUI is ideal for install-config issues (auth, capability setup, project registration, stale baselines, broken paths) but config is NOT GUI-only — the same config item renders across operator brief + CLI what-now/triage + MCP/agent-readable + GUI action card. One model, all surfaces.

NARROW plan-review acknowledgment for lock (NOT a blanket ignore): exactly these symbols are 'unresolved' only because THIS plan defines them — operator_bucket, data_quality, needs_auth, needs_decision, agent_runnable, auto_safe, quiet, uncertain, run_state, state_revision, and the --text flag. They are plan-defined new symbols (the operator_bucket enum + the data_quality envelope + run_state/state_revision concurrency fields + the operator brief --text flag). Every OTHER plan-review finding stays real and must be treated as a genuine prereq/scope/surface issue, not waved through.

F006 NAMED-DEP resolution (per D011): the build writes operator-triage.json into the per-project home caches (~/.dontpanic/dashboard/projects/<name>/) — verified the F006 hook fires there — but the served static dashboard reads <repo>/dashboard/state/. Unifying build-out vs serve-read is a PRE-EXISTING seam affecting ALL state files (the 'No fleet summary yet' screenshots), so it is EXPLICITLY DEFERRED to the serve-path fix, not solved in F006. The operator console renders the model correctly when present (real-shell journey proven); live availability in the served dir is gated on that deferred fix. For today, operator-triage.json is written into the served state dir directly (write_triage_state) so the console renders on the operator's local serve.
